claims.statement: For the explicit 4-component systematic field-cube product over binary modulus X^250+X^59+X^40+X^32+1, with the radius-34 systematic candidate decoder in proof.md for each component, the uniform-message average block error for 1000 information bits on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 271717910866948059/500000000000000000.

The bsc-ops-v1 program for the same field-cube product and its same component decoder uses at most the integer W=15169536873415883759605603631158625363177634308 operations on every received word, with W<=2^(15341/100).

experiments.purpose: Verify the field modulus, exact component occupancy and combined block-error bound, memory and integer exponent inequality, and sample window-arithmetic identities.
